title: IngestionJob
description: The message the Go gateway pushes onto the Redis queue for Python workers to consume. Contains file-level facts only. Go never opens or parses the file contents; content-level facts (text, hash, chunks) are produced by the Python worker.

job_id.description: UUID v4 generated by the gateway. Also used as the stored filename stem.

user_id.description: Identifies which user this document belongs to, for multi-tenant isolation. v1 has no real authentication -- this is a plain string supplied by the client (Streamlit UI or curl), not a verified session. Every chunk derived from this job carries this value in its metadata, and every retrieval query must filter on it. Swapping in real auth later means changing where this value comes from (a verified session instead of a passed field); nothing downstream changes.

original_filename.description: The filename as uploaded by the user, preserved for citation/display.

storage_path.description: Absolute path on the shared volume where the gateway saved the raw file. The worker reads from here.

content_type.description: MIME type the gateway assigned from the file extension. Note: text/csv is accepted at intake for future use, but the v1 worker pipeline does not yet implement CSV loading (deferred to v2).
